title: Census manufacturing-establishment data transition: Final 2021 survey year
summary: Census published the 2021 Annual Survey of Manufactures and identifies it as the final ASM survey year. The final observation retains ASM sampling, revision, industry, and pandemic-period context.
key_findings: Census published the 2021 Annual Survey of Manufactures and identifies it as the final ASM survey year.
Method: Official Census program releases documenting the final ASM observation and the transition to the Annual Integrated Economic Survey.
Denominator: The manufacturing-establishment universe and program scope stated in each Census release.
why_it_matters: This observation adds one of three time points for the census manufacturing-establishment data transition series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for manufacturing cohort and facility production.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: The final observation retains ASM sampling, revision, industry, and pandemic-period context.
The observation is bounded to United States and the stated period.
The denominator is The manufacturing-establishment universe and program scope stated in each Census release.
Two-point movement is not presented as a durable trend without an explicit caveat.
